info.title: GoodJob Job Fit Strategy API
info.description: Read-only recruitment search API for the GoodJob recruitment support-strategy GPT. It searches ALIO, CLEANEYE, corporate recruitment data, and live Work24 job postings. It separates direct role relevance from region-role placement confirmation, uses Work24 detail fields for occupation relevance, filters known false positives, retries transient source failures, and returns clearly marked partial results when necessary.

post.summary: Search recruitment data or create a role-market snapshot

keyword.description: Job or recruitment keyword. Related role terms may be separated by spaces, commas, vertical bars, or slashes.

region.description: Preferred recruitment region such as 울산, 부산, 경남, 전국.

source.description: Use all unless the user explicitly asks for one source. work24 performs live Work24 recruitment lookup.

matchMode.description: Use role for occupation-focused searches. Qualification/preference-only noise and academic specialty false positives are excluded. For Work24, primary occupation is stronger evidence than related occupations or duties.

degraded.description: True when one or more requested data sources still failed after automatic retries.

dataAvailable.description: False when none of the requested data sources could be read. Never interpret an empty result as zero market demand when this is false.

sourceCounts.description: Counts of matched result rows by source. WORK24 means live Work24 results.

quality.description: Includes directRoleMatches, relatedRoleMatches, regionRolePairingNeedsCheck, and confirmedRegionRoleMatches.
